roles.name: Drunken Master
powers: For your combat check, you may roll your Dexterity die ( and you may add the Magic trait) ( and/or the Fire trait); you may not play a weapon on the check.
You may play any number of blessings on your combat check; recharge them instead of discarding them.
When dealt damage other than Combat damage, reduce that damage by 1 ( 2) ( 3).

After you play a boon with the Liquid trait, you may succeed at a Fortitude 6 check to recharge it instead of banishing it.header_type: none; link_faq1: Rise of the Runelords FAQ; issue: Does Sajan the Drunken Master have to attempt a check to recharge potions he would otherwise banish? And when he does so, does he do it before or after triggering the effect of the potion?; answer: No, and after.; resolution: On Sajan's Drunken Master role, change "When you play a boon with the Liquid trait, succeed at a Fortitude 6 check to recharge it instead of banishing it" to "After you play a boon with the Liquid trait, you may succeed at a Fortitude 6 check to recharge it instead of banishing it".; not_altered: The corrected/resolved text is shown above.
Add 6 to your check to acquire a boon with the Liquid trait.
At the start of your turn, you must draw 1 card.
